name: Progress M-52
about: Progress M-52 (2005-007A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 2005 Feb 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2005 Mar  2), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
